newsitem.title: BRAZIL: Brazil Petrobras September output exceeds August.
newsitem.headline: Brazil Petrobras September output exceeds August.

text.p: Brazilian oil production averaged 815,138 barrels per day (bpd) in September, up 5.2 percent from the 774,880 bpd produced in August, state-controlled energy monopoly Petrobras said in a statement.
By the end of the year, Petrobras hopes to raise output to over 900,000 barrels a day, it added.
The increase last month was due to the start-up of a platform in the huge Albacora field in Rio de Janeiro state plus the normalisation of operations at the Marlim site in the same state, it said.
Natural gas production last month was 25.96 million cubic meters a day, up three percent from August's 25.18 million cubic meters a day.
-- Caroline Bulloch, Rio de Janeiro newsroom, 5521 5074151
